result.summary: Several visual layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a suspicious '-100%' badge, cut-off category pills, and partially visible cards that hurt polish and clarity.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail view so names are not cut off.

issues.description: A green badge shows '-100%' on the pizza card, which looks like a broken or incorrect discount label.
issues.suggestion: Verify promo logic and display a clear offer (e.g. '100% off' or 'Free') only when valid; hide malformed percentages.

issues.description: The horizontal category filter row is clipped on the right (partial pill visible), suggesting overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper horizontal scroll padding/fade or show a partial next chip so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so most of the image and context are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards clear the tab bar, or ensure scroll position leaves key content fully visible.

issues.description: Third 'Fastest near you' card is only partially on-screen with no strong scroll cue, making the carousel feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent peek of the next card and/or scroll indicators so horizontal lists feel intentional.
